title.zh-CN: 胸背痛与渐进性无力 · 46岁男性
title.en: Chest and back pain with progressive weakness · 46-year-old man

summary.zh-CN: 胸背痛3年、四肢无力1年并逐渐不能行走，曾按骨质疏松补钙无效。
summary.en: Three years of chest and back pain and a year of weakness, now unable to walk, despite calcium for presumed osteoporosis.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 根据同期配对的血、尿结果识别获得性近端肾小管病（血糖正常时的尿糖、α1微球蛋白尿、低尿酸血症、肾性失钾、高氯性代谢性酸中毒），并在血磷0.53 mmol/L时把24小时尿磷13 mmol判定为肾性失磷。
learningOutcomes.en: Identify an acquired proximal tubulopathy from paired blood and urine results (glycosuria with a normal blood glucose, α1-microglobulinuria, hypouricaemia, renal potassium loss, hyperchloraemic metabolic acidosis), and judge a urine phosphate of 13 mmol/24 h as renal phosphate wasting when the serum phosphate is 0.53 mmol/L.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 把骨痛、多发肋骨骨折、身高下降、ALP升高和持续低血磷解释为可与骨质疏松并存的骨软化，并说明为什么单纯补钙无效。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain bone pain, multiple rib fractures, height loss, a raised ALP and persistent hypophosphataemia as osteomalacia that can coexist with osteoporosis, and explain why calcium alone failed.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 用结构化的药物因果评估（用药时间线、停药反应、排除其他原因）把肾小管病归因于阿德福韦酯，并用已记录的检查排除骨髓瘤/轻链病、原发性甲状旁腺功能亢进、单纯维生素D缺乏和远端肾小管酸中毒。
learningOutcomes.en: Attribute the tubulopathy to adefovir with a structured causality assessment (drug timeline, dechallenge, alternatives) and use the recorded tests to exclude myeloma or light-chain disease, primary hyperparathyroidism, vitamin D deficiency alone and distal renal tubular acidosis.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 依据《慢性乙型肝炎防治指南（2022年版）》和EASL乙肝指南安全换药：停用阿德福韦酯，当天改用恩替卡韦或丙酚替诺福韦，不用TDF、不中断抗病毒；并制定补磷、活性维生素D加钙、补钾和纠正酸中毒的方案及监测。
learningOutcomes.en: Switch antiviral therapy safely according to the Chinese 2022 and EASL hepatitis B guidance — stop adefovir and start entecavir or tenofovir alafenamide the same day, never TDF and never a gap — and plan phosphate, active vitamin D with calcium, potassium and alkali, with monitoring.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 说明为什么在消瘦、长期卧床的患者中“肌酐正常”会掩盖肾损害，并列出长期服用核苷酸类似物者除肌酐外应监测的指标（作者建议：GFR、ALP、血气、24小时尿蛋白及尿钾、钙、磷，血磷）。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain why a 'normal' creatinine hid kidney damage in a thin, bed-bound man, and list what long-term nucleotide-analogue users need monitored beyond creatinine (the authors' list: GFR, ALP, blood gas, 24-hour urine protein, urine potassium, calcium and phosphate, and serum phosphate).

personality.zh-CN: 46岁男性，被疼痛和无力折腾了三年，跑过好几家医院，有些疲惫和无奈，但愿意配合，回答直接。
personality.en: A 46-year-old man worn down by three years of pain and weakness and several hospitals; tired and a little resigned, but cooperative and straightforward.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 朴实的口语，句子短；按自己的理解讲症状、看过的医生和吃过的药，不用医学术语；记不清的直接说记不清。
speechStyle.en: Plain, everyday speech in short sentences; describes symptoms, doctors and tablets in his own words without medical terms, and says so when he can't remember.

openingLine.zh-CN: 医生，我这胸口后背疼了三年了，这一年腿也越来越没劲，现在连路都走不了。
openingLine.en: Doctor, my chest and back have hurt for three years, and over this last year my legs have got weaker and weaker — now I can't even walk.

actingNotes.zh-CN: 入院时躺在病床上，翻身、坐起都慢而吃力，动的时候会皱眉；换药后的住院后期和随访时疼痛已明显减轻，按当时的情况回答。只讲已经问到的病史事实，用自己的话说，不增减数字、时间和药名；不解释化验，不谈诊断。
actingNotes.en: On admission he lies in bed; turning and sitting up are slow and effortful and he winces when he moves. Later in the admission and at follow-up the pain is much better — answer for that time. Only state history facts that have been asked about, in your own words, without adding or changing numbers, times or drug names; do not interpret tests or talk about a diagnosis.

name.zh-CN: 住院治疗记录（原报告）

text.zh-CN: 入院第9天停用阿德福韦酯，给予恩替卡韦0.5 mg每日1次口服，碳酸钙D3 0.6 g每日1次，骨化三醇胶丸1 μg每日1次，氯化钾口服溶液补钾；另给甘草酸二铵100 mg每日3次口服、还原型谷胱甘肽1.8 g每日1次静脉滴注、护肝宁片4片每日3次。第11天血磷0.57 mmol/L，作者认为肾小管损伤所致的尿磷丢失短期内不能恢复，加用补磷（制剂和剂量未记录）。第14天血磷0.71 mmol/L。第18天胸背疼痛明显好转，行走时四肢仍乏力但较前好转，出院；出院后继续恩替卡韦0.5 mg每日1次，并继续补磷、补钙。
text.en: On hospital day 9 adefovir was stopped and entecavir 0.5 mg orally once daily started, with calcium carbonate–vitamin D₃ 0.6 g once daily, calcitriol capsules 1 μg once daily and oral potassium chloride solution; diammonium glycyrrhizinate 100 mg orally three times daily, reduced glutathione 1.8 g IV once daily and Huganning tablets 4 three times daily were also given. On day 11 the phosphate was 0.57 mmol/L; judging that the tubular phosphate leak would not recover quickly, the team added phosphate supplements (preparation and dose not recorded). Day 14: phosphate 0.71 mmol/L. On day 18 the chest and back pain was much better and his limbs, though still weak when walking, were improving; he went home on entecavir 0.5 mg once daily with continued phosphate and calcium.

note.zh-CN: 原文把甘草酸二铵写作“甘草酸二胺”。原报告没有记录碱剂。
note.en: The report spells diammonium glycyrrhizinate '甘草酸二胺'. No alkali is recorded.

name.zh-CN: 建立外周静脉通路

dose.zh-CN: 立即停用，并在同一天换用其他抗乙肝病毒药物。

name.zh-CN: 恩替卡韦0.5 mg每日1次口服

dose.zh-CN: 恩替卡韦0.5 mg口服，每日1次，空腹（餐前或餐后至少2小时）；肌酐清除率< 50 mL/min时按说明书减量或延长间隔。

response.zh-CN: 恩替卡韦已开始（与原报告相同）。药师提醒：空腹服用；每3–6个月复查HBV DNA和肝肾功能。
response.en: Entecavir started (as in the report). The pharmacist reminds him to take it on an empty stomach and plans HBV DNA and liver and kidney tests every 3–6 months.

name.zh-CN: 丙酚替诺福韦（TAF）25 mg每日1次口服
name.en: Tenofovir alafenamide (TAF) 25 mg orally once daily

dose.zh-CN: 丙酚替诺福韦25 mg口服，每日1次，随餐；治疗期间监测肾功能、血磷和尿蛋白、尿糖。
dose.en: Tenofovir alafenamide 25 mg orally once daily with food; monitor kidney function, serum phosphate and urine protein and glucose during treatment.

response.zh-CN: TAF已开始。药师提醒：TAF的血浆替诺福韦浓度远低于TDF，肾和骨安全性更好，但仍属替诺福韦前药，需按计划复查肾小管指标。原报告用的是恩替卡韦。
response.en: TAF started. The pharmacist notes that TAF gives far lower plasma tenofovir than TDF with better kidney and bone safety, but it is still a tenofovir prodrug, so tubular markers must be rechecked as planned. The report used entecavir.

name.zh-CN: 富马酸替诺福韦二吡呋酯（TDF）300 mg每日1次口服
name.en: Tenofovir disoproxil fumarate (TDF) 300 mg orally once daily

harm.zh-CN: TDF与阿德福韦酯同属核苷酸类似物，同样经近端小管有机阴离子转运体摄取，可引起范科尼综合征、低磷和骨量丢失；已出现药物性范科尼综合征和骨软化时应改用恩替卡韦或TAF（《慢性乙型肝炎防治指南（2022年版）》）。药师已拦截并建议更换。
harm.en: TDF, like adefovir, is a nucleotide analogue taken up by proximal-tubular organic anion transporters and can cause Fanconi syndrome, hypophosphataemia and bone loss; with drug-induced Fanconi syndrome and osteomalacia already present, switch to entecavir or TAF instead (Chinese 2022 hepatitis B guideline). The pharmacist has queried the order and suggests a change.

response.zh-CN: 医嘱已录入，药师来电质疑。
response.en: The order is entered; the pharmacist phones to query it.

name.zh-CN: 停用全部抗乙肝病毒药物，等肾小管恢复后再说
name.en: Stop all hepatitis B treatment until the tubule recovers

dose.zh-CN: 停用所有核苷（酸）类似物。

harm.zh-CN: 停用核苷（酸）类似物可导致乙肝病毒反弹和肝炎急性加重，严重时肝衰竭；阿德福韦酯说明书黑框警告包括停药后肝炎严重急性加重。应在停用致病药的同一天换用恩替卡韦或TAF。
harm.en: Stopping nucleos(t)ide therapy can cause viral rebound and an acute hepatitis flare, in severe cases liver failure; the adefovir label carries a boxed warning of severe acute exacerbations of hepatitis after discontinuation. Replace the culprit with entecavir or TAF the same day.

response.zh-CN: 所有抗病毒药已停。护士问：“他的乙肝谁来管？”
response.en: All antivirals are stopped. The nurse asks: “Who's looking after his hepatitis B now?”

name.zh-CN: 继续阿德福韦酯，改为10 mg隔日1次
name.en: Continue adefovir at 10 mg every other day

dose.zh-CN: 阿德福韦酯10 mg口服，每48小时1次。
dose.en: Adefovir dipivoxil 10 mg orally every 48 hours.

harm.zh-CN: 延长给药间隔是针对肌酐清除率下降时的药物蓄积，并不能消除已引起范科尼综合征的肾小管毒性；继续用药会让肾小管损伤和失磷持续。
harm.en: A longer interval addresses accumulation when creatinine clearance falls; it does not remove a tubular toxicity that has already caused Fanconi syndrome, so the tubular injury and phosphate loss go on.

response.en: The prescription is changed to every other day.

name.zh-CN: 口服补磷

dose.zh-CN: 口服磷制剂，分次服用，按血磷调整剂量（原报告未记录制剂和剂量）；可有腹泻，监测血磷、血钙。
dose.en: Oral phosphate in divided doses, titrated to serum phosphate (the report does not record the preparation or dose); can cause diarrhoea; monitor serum phosphate and calcium.

response.zh-CN: 已开始口服补磷。原报告在入院第11天血磷仍为0.57 mmol/L时才加用补磷。
response.en: Oral phosphate started. In the report it was added on hospital day 11, when the phosphate was still 0.57 mmol/L.

name.zh-CN: 骨化三醇1 μg每日1次口服

dose.zh-CN: 骨化三醇胶丸1 μg口服，每日1次（原报告剂量）；监测血钙，避免高钙血症。
dose.en: Calcitriol capsules 1 μg orally once daily (the report's dose); monitor serum calcium to avoid hypercalcaemia.

response.zh-CN: 骨化三醇已开始（与原报告相同）。

name.zh-CN: 碳酸钙D3 0.6 g每日1次口服
name.en: Calcium carbonate–vitamin D₃ 0.6 g orally once daily

dose.zh-CN: 碳酸钙D3 0.6 g口服，每日1次（原报告剂量）。
dose.en: Calcium carbonate–vitamin D₃ 0.6 g orally once daily (the report's dose).

response.zh-CN: 钙剂已开始（与原报告相同）。单用钙剂在骨科时并未见效，需要与补磷和骨化三醇一起用。
response.en: Calcium started (as in the report). On its own it did not help in orthopaedics; it belongs with phosphate and calcitriol.

name.zh-CN: 氯化钾口服溶液

dose.zh-CN: 氯化钾口服溶液，按血钾调整剂量（原报告未记录剂量）。
dose.en: Oral potassium chloride solution, titrated to serum potassium (the report does not record the dose).

response.zh-CN: 已开始口服氯化钾（与原报告相同）。注意：氯化钾补钾但不纠正高氯性酸中毒。
response.en: Oral potassium chloride started (as in the report). Note that it replaces potassium but does nothing for the hyperchloraemic acidosis.

name.zh-CN: 枸橼酸钾口服（补钾并纠正酸中毒）

dose.zh-CN: 枸橼酸钾口服，分次服用，按血钾和碳酸氢根调整；碱剂会增加尿钾排出，不能只补碱不补钾。
dose.en: Oral potassium citrate in divided doses, titrated to serum potassium and bicarbonate; alkali increases urinary potassium loss, so never give alkali without potassium.

response.zh-CN: 已开始枸橼酸钾，计划复查血钾和血气。原报告没有记录碱剂。
response.en: Potassium citrate started, with potassium and a blood gas to be rechecked. The report records no alkali.

name.zh-CN: 甘草酸二铵100 mg每日3次口服
name.en: Diammonium glycyrrhizinate 100 mg orally three times daily

dose.zh-CN: 甘草酸二铵100 mg口服，每日3次（原报告用药）。
dose.en: Diammonium glycyrrhizinate 100 mg orally three times daily (as in the report).

response.zh-CN: 已开（原报告也用了）。原报告没有记录入院时的肝酶，入院前5个月肝功能正常，HBV DNA已被抑制：这类保肝药在本例没有记录到明确指征，还可能加重水钠潴留和低钾。
response.en: Prescribed (the report used it too). The report gives no admission liver enzymes, liver function was normal 5 months earlier and HBV DNA is suppressed: no clear indication for this liver drug is recorded here, and glycyrrhizin preparations can worsen sodium retention and hypokalaemia.

name.zh-CN: 还原型谷胱甘肽1.8 g每日1次静脉滴注
name.en: Reduced glutathione 1.8 g IV once daily

dose.zh-CN: 还原型谷胱甘肽1.8 g静脉滴注，每日1次（原报告用药）。
dose.en: Reduced glutathione 1.8 g by IV infusion once daily (as in the report).

response.zh-CN: 已开（原报告也用了）。本例没有记录到使用指征，却多了一条静脉通路和每日输液。
response.en: Prescribed (the report used it too). No indication is recorded here, and it adds an IV line and a daily infusion.

name.zh-CN: 护肝宁片4片每日3次口服

dose.zh-CN: 护肝宁片4片口服，每日3次（原报告用药，中成药）。
dose.en: Huganning tablets (a Chinese patent liver preparation) 4 three times daily (as in the report).

response.zh-CN: 已开（原报告也用了）。本例没有记录到明确的保肝指征。
response.en: Prescribed (the report used it too). No clear liver indication is recorded here.

name.zh-CN: 阿仑膦酸钠70 mg每周1次口服

dose.zh-CN: 阿仑膦酸钠70 mg，每周1次，晨起空腹整片吞服。
dose.en: Alendronate 70 mg once weekly, swallowed whole on waking, fasting.

harm.zh-CN: 他的骨病主要是失磷导致的矿化障碍（骨软化）。双膦酸盐不能纠正矿化缺陷：应先补磷、活性维生素D，纠正骨软化后再评估骨密度和是否需要抗骨质疏松治疗。
harm.en: His bone disease is mainly a mineralisation defect from phosphate loss (osteomalacia). A bisphosphonate does not correct a mineralisation defect: replace phosphate and active vitamin D first, and reassess bone density and any need for osteoporosis treatment once the osteomalacia has healed.

name.zh-CN: 上报疑似药品不良反应
name.en: Report the suspected adverse drug reaction

dose.zh-CN: 填写《药品不良反应/事件报告表》，按规定上报（药品不良反应报告和监测管理办法）。
dose.en: Complete the adverse drug reaction/event report form and submit it as the national reporting rules require.

response.zh-CN: 报告已提交，药师协助填写了用药时间线和停药后的变化。
response.en: The report is submitted; the pharmacist helps record the drug timeline and the response to stopping.

title.en: Take the history: the course and the medicines

hint.zh-CN: 从三年前起病往后问：哪里疼、还能不能走、看过哪些医生、做过什么、补过什么、效果如何；再问长期的病和长期吃的药——药名、剂量、吃了多久。
hint.en: Work forward from the first symptoms three years ago: where it hurts, whether he can walk, who he saw, what was done and what he was given, and whether it helped; then ask about long-term illnesses and long-term tablets — name, dose and how long.

guidance.zh-CN: 到病床旁问诊：病程、行走能力、既往就诊和补钙效果，以及乙肝和长期用药。
guidance.en: At the bedside, take the history: the course, his walking, earlier visits and the calcium, then his hepatitis B and long-term medicines.

hint.zh-CN: 先看生命体征和体型；再按压脊柱、肩胛骨和肋骨，最后查肌力。
hint.en: Start with his observations and build; then press over the spine, scapulae and ribs, and test his power.

guidance.zh-CN: 在床旁完成生命体征、一般情况、骨骼压痛和肌力检查。
guidance.en: At the bedside, check his observations, general appearance, bony tenderness and power.

title.zh-CN: 成对解读血液和尿液结果
title.en: Read the blood and urine results as pairs

hint.zh-CN: 同一时间的血糖正常时，尿糖说明什么？血里缺磷的时候，健康的肾脏会怎样处理尿里的磷？血气和血氯放在一起看说明什么？
hint.en: What does glycosuria mean when the blood glucose taken at the same time is normal? When the body is short of phosphate, what does a healthy kidney do with it? What do the blood gas and the chloride say when you read them together?

guidance.zh-CN: 在床旁留取血、尿标本（血生化、尿常规、24小时尿、血气），在病历终端调阅结果，然后在会诊板作答。
guidance.en: Take blood and urine at the bedside (chemistry, urinalysis, 24-hour urine, blood gas), read the results at a records terminal, then answer on the case board.

title.zh-CN: 排除相似疾病，作出统一诊断
title.en: Rule out the look-alikes and make one diagnosis

hint.zh-CN: 五个月前的化验其实已经提示过什么？哪些结果能排除骨髓瘤和甲状旁腺功能亢进？他的维生素D能解释全部异常吗？
hint.en: What had the tests five months ago already shown? Which results rule out myeloma and hyperparathyroidism? Can his vitamin D explain everything?

guidance.zh-CN: 在病历终端调阅入院前的化验和影像记录；申请骨髓检查和维生素D；然后在会诊板作出诊断。
guidance.en: Read the earlier blood results and imaging at a records terminal, request the marrow and vitamin D, then make the diagnosis on the case board.

title.zh-CN: 安全换药并开始代谢治疗
title.en: Change the antiviral safely and start metabolic treatment

hint.zh-CN: 可疑药物停掉以后，谁来继续压住乙肝病毒？血里缺的磷、碱和钾分别怎么补，怎样监测？
hint.en: Once the suspect drug stops, what keeps the hepatitis B suppressed? How will you make up what his blood is short of — phosphate, base and potassium — and how will you monitor it?

guidance.zh-CN: 在会诊板完成换药和代谢治疗两项决策，然后开出医嘱：停药、换用的抗病毒药、补磷和骨化三醇。
guidance.en: Answer the antiviral and metabolic decisions on the case board, then prescribe: stop the drug, start the replacement antiviral, phosphate and calcitriol.

title.en: Review the hospital course and the follow-up

hint.zh-CN: 换药以后血磷恢复得有多快？出院时和出院半年后他分别怎样？
hint.en: How fast did his phosphate recover once the drug was changed? How was he at discharge, and six months later?

guidance.zh-CN: 在病历终端调阅原报告的住院治疗记录、复查的血磷和出院时的24小时尿；随访阶段开放后调阅随访记录。
guidance.en: At a records terminal, read the report's inpatient record, the repeat phosphate and the discharge 24-hour urine; once follow-up opens, read the follow-up record.

prompt.zh-CN: 入院时血磷0.53 mmol/L，24小时尿磷13 mmol（实验室参考值16–48 mmol/24 h）。这个尿磷应如何解读？
prompt.en: On admission his serum phosphate is 0.53 mmol/L and his 24-hour urine phosphate 13 mmol (laboratory range 16–48 mmol/24 h). How should you read the urine phosphate?

need.zh-CN: 先查看入院血生化和24小时尿检查。
need.en: Read the admission blood chemistry and the 24-hour urine first.

text.zh-CN: 不适当地高：血磷这么低时肾脏应几乎不排磷，每天约400 mg的尿磷说明肾脏在漏磷
text.en: Inappropriately high: with a serum phosphate this low the kidney should excrete almost none, so about 400 mg a day means the kidney is leaking phosphate

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。13 mmol/24 h约等于400 mg/日（13 × 31 mg）。低磷血症时，肾小管应几乎全部重吸收滤过的磷，尿磷应接近零；实验室参考值（16–48 mmol/24 h）描述的是血磷正常、按饮食排磷的人，不能用来判断低磷时肾脏的反应。作者也把低血磷归因于“尿磷排泄增多”。磷排泄分数或TmP/GFR更精确，但本例未报告尿肌酐，无法计算。
feedback.en: Correct. 13 mmol/24 h is about 400 mg a day (13 × 31 mg). In hypophosphataemia the tubule should reabsorb nearly all the filtered phosphate, so urinary phosphate should fall towards zero; the laboratory range (16–48 mmol/24 h) describes people with a normal serum phosphate excreting what they eat and cannot judge the kidney's response to a low level. The authors also put the low phosphate down to 'increased urinary phosphate excretion'. FEPO₄ or TmP/GFR would be more precise, but no urine creatinine was reported, so neither can be calculated.

text.zh-CN: 偏低：13 mmol低于参考值16–48 mmol/24 h，说明肾脏在恰当地保磷，应找摄入不足、肠道丢失或吸收不良
text.en: Low: 13 mmol is below the laboratory range of 16–48 mmol/24 h, so the kidney is conserving phosphate appropriately — look for poor intake, gut loss or malabsorption

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。这是用血磷正常人群的参考值去衡量低磷状态。肾脏真正在保磷时（如摄入不足、肠道丢失），尿磷会降到很低；每天约400 mg远高于此。加上血糖正常时的尿糖、α1微球蛋白尿和尿钾丢失，问题出在近端肾小管。
feedback.en: No. This measures a low-phosphate state against a range for people with a normal phosphate. A kidney that is truly conserving phosphate — after poor intake or gut loss — drives urinary phosphate very low; about 400 mg a day is far above that. Add the glycosuria with a normal blood glucose, the α1-microglobulinuria and the urinary potassium loss, and the problem is in the proximal tubule.

text.zh-CN: 无法解读：没有尿肌酐就算不出磷排泄分数或TmP/GFR，单凭24小时尿磷总量不能判断是否存在肾性失磷
text.en: Uninterpretable: with no urine creatinine there is no fractional excretion or TmP/GFR, and a 24-hour total alone cannot show whether he is wasting phosphate

feedback.zh-CN: 前半句对，结论错。FEPO₄或TmP/GFR确实更精确，本例也无法计算；但在低磷血症时，绝对尿磷已经很有信息量：每天约400 mg不可能是肾脏在保磷。缺少更好的指标，不是放弃已有证据的理由。
feedback.en: Half right, wrong conclusion. FEPO₄ or TmP/GFR are more precise and cannot be calculated here, but in hypophosphataemia the absolute urinary phosphate already says a lot: about 400 mg a day cannot be a kidney conserving phosphate. Lacking a better index is no reason to discard the evidence you have.

text.zh-CN: 提示磷向细胞内转移（如再喂养、呼吸性碱中毒）：尿磷只是随血磷降低而减少，与肾脏无关
text.en: It points to phosphate shifting into cells, as in refeeding or respiratory alkalosis: the urinary phosphate simply follows the low serum level and says nothing about the kidney

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。磷向细胞内转移时，尿磷会随血磷一起下降，而不会每天排出约400 mg；本例也没有再喂养的情境。低血磷同时伴有不适当的高尿磷，说明问题在肾小管。
feedback.en: No. When phosphate shifts into cells, the urinary phosphate falls with the serum level rather than running at about 400 mg a day, and there is no refeeding here. A low serum phosphate with an inappropriately high urinary phosphate puts the problem in the tubule.

prompt.zh-CN: 哪一个诊断能同时解释他的骨病和这些血、尿异常？
prompt.en: Which diagnosis explains both his bone disease and these blood and urine abnormalities?

need.zh-CN: 先问清长期用药；查看血生化、尿常规、24小时尿、血气、维生素D、骨髓检查和入院前骨科化验。
need.en: Take the long-term medication history and read the blood chemistry, urinalysis, 24-hour urine, blood gas, vitamin D, marrow and the earlier orthopaedic blood results first.

text.zh-CN: 阿德福韦酯引起的获得性近端肾小管病（范科尼综合征）伴低磷性骨软化，发生在用药近10年后
text.en: Adefovir-induced acquired proximal tubulopathy (Fanconi syndrome) with hypophosphataemic osteomalacia, after nearly ten years on the drug

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。血糖4.1 mmol/L时尿糖++，α1微球蛋白168 mg/L（低分子量蛋白尿），尿酸117 μmol/L，血钾3.1 mmol/L而尿钾79 mmol/24 h，高氯性代谢性酸中毒（Cl⁻ 111 mmol/L，HCO₃⁻ 13 mmol/L），加上不适当的尿磷，构成近端小管多项转运缺陷。骨痛、多发肋骨骨折、身高下降、ALP 201 U/L和至少5个月的低血磷指向骨软化，并可与骨质疏松并存。他服用核苷酸类似物阿德福韦酯近10年；骨髓正常、既往血钙和PTH正常，使骨髓瘤和甲旁亢不太可能。接下来停药后的变化（停药反应）是因果判断的下一项证据。
feedback.en: Correct. Glycosuria ++ with a blood glucose of 4.1 mmol/L, α1-microglobulin 168 mg/L (low-molecular-weight proteinuria), urate 117 μmol/L, potassium 3.1 mmol/L with 79 mmol a day in the urine, a hyperchloraemic metabolic acidosis (Cl⁻ 111, HCO₃⁻ 13 mmol/L) and inappropriate phosphaturia add up to a generalised proximal tubular transport defect. Bone pain, multiple rib fractures, height loss, ALP 201 U/L and at least five months of hypophosphataemia point to osteomalacia, which can coexist with osteoporosis. He has taken the nucleotide analogue adefovir for nearly ten years; a normal marrow and the earlier normal calcium and PTH make myeloma and hyperparathyroidism unlikely. What happens after the drug is stopped (dechallenge) is the next piece of causal evidence.

text.zh-CN: 多发性骨髓瘤伴轻链近端肾小管病：骨折为病理性骨折，骨痛和蛋白尿也都相符
text.en: Multiple myeloma with light-chain proximal tubulopathy: the fractures are pathological, and the bone pain and proteinuria fit too

feedback.zh-CN: 合理的鉴别，但证据不支持。成人起病的范科尼综合征伴骨痛、骨折必须想到骨髓瘤或轻链病；本例骨髓象基本正常，血液肿瘤指标无异常。原文没有列出具体项目（如血清蛋白电泳、免疫固定电泳、游离轻链），这是记录的局限。
feedback.en: A sensible differential that the evidence does not support. Adult-onset Fanconi syndrome with bone pain and fractures must raise myeloma or light-chain disease; here the marrow was essentially normal and the haematological tumour markers were normal. The report does not list which markers were measured (such as serum protein electrophoresis, immunofixation or free light chains) — a limit of the record.

text.zh-CN: 单纯维生素D缺乏引起的骨软化：25-羟维生素D偏低，伴ALP升高、低血磷和骨痛，单补钙未能纠正
text.en: Osteomalacia from vitamin D deficiency alone: a low 25-hydroxyvitamin D with a raised ALP, a low phosphate and bone pain that calcium alone has not corrected

feedback.zh-CN: 不完整。25-羟维生素D偏低（原文36.97，单位印作mmol/L，数量级相当于nmol/L）可能加重骨软化；但单纯维生素D缺乏不会造成血糖正常时的尿糖、α1微球蛋白尿、低尿酸、尿钾丢失和高氯性酸中毒，而且通常伴PTH升高——入院前5个月PTH正常。
feedback.en: Incomplete. A low 25-hydroxyvitamin D (printed as 36.97 'mmol/L', a magnitude that fits nmol/L) may add to the osteomalacia, but vitamin D deficiency alone does not cause glycosuria with a normal blood glucose, α1-microglobulinuria, hypouricaemia, urinary potassium loss or a hyperchloraemic acidosis, and it usually raises the PTH — which was normal five months earlier.

text.zh-CN: 远端（Ⅰ型）肾小管酸中毒：高氯性代谢性酸中毒伴低钾和尿钾丢失，并由此导致骨病
text.en: Distal (type 1) renal tubular acidosis: a hyperchloraemic metabolic acidosis with hypokalaemia and urinary potassium loss, causing the bone disease

feedback.zh-CN: 只符合一部分。高氯性酸中毒和低钾两者都有，但远端肾小管酸中毒不会出现血糖正常时的尿糖、低分子量蛋白尿和低尿酸，低磷性骨软化也指向近端小管漏磷。原文未报告尿pH，无法据此进一步区分。
feedback.en: It fits only part of the picture. Distal RTA shares the hyperchloraemic acidosis and hypokalaemia, but not glycosuria with a normal blood glucose, low-molecular-weight proteinuria or hypouricaemia, and hypophosphataemic osteomalacia points to a proximal phosphate leak. Urine pH was not reported, so it cannot help here.

text.zh-CN: 原发性骨质疏松，即此前的诊断：骨科查血钙和PTH正常，肌酐103 μmol/L也正常，可以排除肾脏问题
text.en: Primary osteoporosis, the working diagnosis so far: calcium and PTH were normal in orthopaedics, and a normal creatinine of 103 μmol/L rules out a kidney problem

feedback.zh-CN: 这正是过去三年的误诊。骨质疏松不会引起低血磷、ALP升高、尿糖或酸中毒，补钙也没有效果。肌酐103 μmol/L看似正常（按CKD-EPI 2021估算eGFR约78 mL/min/1.73 m²），但他消瘦、长期不能行走，肌肉量少会让肌酐掩盖肾损害；而且肾小管功能可以在肌酐正常时严重受损。
feedback.en: This is the misdiagnosis of the past three years. Osteoporosis does not cause hypophosphataemia, a raised ALP, glycosuria or acidosis, and calcium did not help. A creatinine of 103 μmol/L looks normal (CKD-EPI 2021 eGFR about 78 mL/min/1.73 m²), but he is thin and has not walked for months, and low muscle mass lets the creatinine hide kidney damage; tubular function can also be badly damaged while the creatinine is normal.

prompt.zh-CN: 已经判断与阿德福韦酯有关。他的乙肝抗病毒治疗应如何调整？
prompt.en: You have linked the problem to adefovir. How should his hepatitis B treatment change?

need.zh-CN: 先作出诊断，并查看乙肝血清学和HBV DNA。
need.en: Make the diagnosis and read the hepatitis B serology and HBV DNA first.

text.zh-CN: 停用阿德福韦酯，当天改用恩替卡韦（原报告做法）或丙酚替诺福韦，不中断抑制病毒，并监测HBV DNA
text.en: Stop adefovir and switch the same day to entecavir (as reported) or tenofovir alafenamide, with no gap in suppression; monitor HBV DNA

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。他HBsAg阳性，HBV DNA低于检测下限（< 4.2 × 10² copies/mL），说明病毒被抑制，治疗必须继续。《慢性乙型肝炎防治指南（2022年版）》建议：用阿德福韦酯或TDF的患者出现肾脏或骨骼疾病（或高风险）时改用恩替卡韦或TAF；EASL乙肝指南自2017年版起也对有肾、骨风险者首选这两种药。恩替卡韦是核苷类似物，没有近端小管毒性（肌酐清除率< 50 mL/min时调整剂量）；TAF的血浆替诺福韦浓度低，肾和骨安全性优于TDF，但仍需监测肾小管指标。
feedback.en: Correct. He is HBsAg-positive with HBV DNA below the limit of detection (< 4.2 × 10² copies/mL): suppression is working and must continue. The Chinese 2022 hepatitis B guideline advises switching patients on adefovir or TDF who develop kidney or bone disease (or are at high risk of them) to entecavir or TAF, and EASL hepatitis B guidance has preferred the same two drugs for kidney or bone risk since its 2017 edition. Entecavir is a nucleoside analogue without proximal tubular toxicity (its dose is adjusted when creatinine clearance is < 50 mL/min); TAF gives low plasma tenofovir and safer kidney and bone profiles than TDF, though tubular markers still need watching.

text.zh-CN: 当天改用富马酸替诺福韦二吡呋酯（TDF）：抗病毒作用强于阿德福韦酯、耐药少，可持续抑制HBV DNA
text.en: Switch the same day to tenofovir disoproxil fumarate (TDF): more potent than adefovir, with little resistance, so the HBV DNA stays suppressed

feedback.zh-CN: 不对，而且有害。TDF与阿德福韦酯同属无环核苷酸类似物，同样经近端小管有机阴离子转运体摄取，可引起范科尼综合征、低磷和骨量丢失；作者在讨论中也指出这类药物在近曲小管蓄积。指南建议肾损害或骨病患者用恩替卡韦或TAF，而不是ADV或TDF。
feedback.en: No — and harmful. TDF, like adefovir, is an acyclic nucleotide analogue taken up by proximal-tubular organic anion transporters and can cause Fanconi syndrome, hypophosphataemia and bone loss; the authors also describe these drugs concentrating in the proximal tubule. The guidelines advise entecavir or TAF, not ADV or TDF, for patients with kidney or bone disease.

text.zh-CN: HBV DNA已测不到，先停用所有抗乙肝病毒药，等肾小管恢复后再决定换用什么药
text.en: Stop all hepatitis B treatment, as the HBV DNA is already undetectable, and decide on a new drug once the tubule has recovered

feedback.zh-CN: 不对，而且危险。停用核苷（酸）类似物可导致病毒反弹和肝炎急性加重，严重时肝衰竭；阿德福韦酯说明书的黑框警告就包括停药后肝炎严重急性加重。应在停用致病药的同一天换用没有肾小管毒性的药物，让病毒持续受抑制。
feedback.en: No — and dangerous. Stopping nucleos(t)ide therapy can cause viral rebound and an acute hepatitis flare, in severe cases liver failure; the adefovir label's boxed warning includes severe acute exacerbations of hepatitis after discontinuation. Replace the culprit the same day with a drug free of tubular toxicity so that suppression continues.

text.zh-CN: 继续用阿德福韦酯（HBV DNA已被抑制），按肾功能延长给药间隔，同时加大补钙
text.en: Continue adefovir, under which the HBV DNA is suppressed, at a longer dosing interval for his kidney function, and give more calcium

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。延长给药间隔针对的是肌酐清除率下降时的药物蓄积，并不能消除已经造成范科尼综合征的肾小管毒性。作者讨论中提到“调整剂量或改用其他药物”，但已经出现范科尼综合征和骨软化时应停药换药。多补钙也纠正不了失磷——骨科给的钙剂并没有见效。
feedback.en: No. A longer interval addresses accumulation when creatinine clearance falls; it does not remove a tubular toxicity that has already caused Fanconi syndrome. The authors' discussion mentions 'adjusting the dose or changing the drug', but once Fanconi syndrome and osteomalacia are present the drug must be changed. More calcium does not correct phosphate wasting — the calcium given in orthopaedics did not help.

prompt.zh-CN: 停药换药的同时，哪些代谢治疗应该现在就开始？（选出所有正确项）
prompt.en: Alongside the drug change, which metabolic treatments should start now? (Select all that apply.)

need.zh-CN: 先作出诊断，并查看血气和25-羟维生素D结果。
need.en: Make the diagnosis and read the blood gas and 25-hydroxyvitamin D first.

text.zh-CN: 口服补磷，分次服用，按血磷调整：停药后肾小管漏磷还会持续数周到数月
text.en: Oral phosphate in divided doses, titrated to serum phosphate: the tubular leak goes on for weeks to months after the drug is stopped

feedback.zh-CN: 应选。低血磷是骨软化的直接原因，诊断时就应补磷；作者在讨论中也建议“一旦出现低血磷，应及时补磷”。原报告起初只给了钙剂和骨化三醇，住院后期才加用补磷——今天应从诊断时开始。
feedback.en: Yes. Hypophosphataemia drives the osteomalacia, so phosphate should start at diagnosis; the authors themselves advise prompt phosphate replacement once hypophosphataemia appears. The report first gave calcium and calcitriol only and added phosphate later in the admission — today you would start it at diagnosis.

text.zh-CN: 活性维生素D（骨化三醇）加钙剂（原报告：骨化三醇1 μg/日、碳酸钙D3 0.6 g/日），监测血钙
text.en: Active vitamin D (calcitriol) with calcium (the report: calcitriol 1 μg a day and calcium carbonate–vitamin D₃ 0.6 g a day), monitoring serum calcium

feedback.zh-CN: 应选。活性维生素D增加肠道钙、磷吸收，帮助骨矿化，与补磷合用是低磷性骨软化的常规做法；作者也建议已有骨质疏松或骨折者同时用活性维生素D和钙剂。注意监测血钙，避免高钙血症。
feedback.en: Yes. Active vitamin D increases gut calcium and phosphate absorption and helps mineralisation; with phosphate it is the usual treatment for hypophosphataemic osteomalacia, and the authors recommend active vitamin D with calcium for patients who already have osteoporosis or fractures. Monitor the serum calcium for hypercalcaemia.

text.zh-CN: 补钾并纠正代谢性酸中毒：用枸橼酸钾这类含碱的钾盐，监测血钾和碳酸氢根
text.en: Replace the potassium and correct the metabolic acidosis with an alkali potassium salt such as potassium citrate, monitoring K⁺ and HCO₃⁻

feedback.zh-CN: 应选。血钾3.1 mmol/L伴尿钾丢失，HCO₃⁻ 13 mmol/L、pH 7.24的酸中毒会加重骨病和乏力。近端小管性酸中毒需要碱剂；枸橼酸钾同时补钾和碱，而碱剂会增加尿钾排出，所以不能只补碱不补钾。原报告用的是氯化钾口服溶液，没有记录碱剂——氯离子对高氯性酸中毒没有帮助。药物性范科尼综合征没有专门指南，这是肾内科的常规做法，宜与肾内科共同管理。
feedback.en: Yes. Potassium 3.1 mmol/L with urinary potassium loss, and an acidosis with HCO₃⁻ 13 mmol/L and pH 7.24, worsen the bone disease and the weakness. Proximal tubular acidosis needs an alkali; potassium citrate gives potassium and alkali together, and because alkali increases urinary potassium loss it should never be given without potassium. The report used oral potassium chloride and records no alkali — chloride does nothing for a hyperchloraemic acidosis. There is no specific guideline for drug-induced Fanconi syndrome; this is standard nephrology practice, best agreed with the renal team.

text.zh-CN: 现在加用双膦酸盐（如阿仑膦酸钠70 mg每周1次），治疗“重度骨质疏松”和骨折
text.en: Start a bisphosphonate (such as alendronate 70 mg weekly) now for the 'severe osteoporosis' and the fractures

feedback.zh-CN: 不应选。他的骨病主要是失磷导致的矿化障碍（骨软化），抗骨吸收药不能纠正矿化缺陷。应先补磷、补充活性维生素D，待骨软化纠正后再评估骨密度和是否需要抗骨质疏松治疗。
feedback.en: No. His bone disease is mainly a mineralisation defect caused by phosphate loss (osteomalacia), and antiresorptive drugs do not correct a mineralisation defect. Replace phosphate and active vitamin D first, then reassess bone density and any need for osteoporosis treatment once the osteomalacia has healed.

text.zh-CN: 停用阿德福韦酯后肾小管会很快恢复，继续补钙即可，暂不补磷，几天后复查血磷再决定
text.en: The tubule recovers quickly once adefovir is stopped, so continue calcium, hold off on phosphate and recheck the serum phosphate in a few days before adding it

feedback.zh-CN: 不应选。药物性近端小管损伤恢复慢，往往需要数周到数月，部分患者恢复不完全；继续低磷会让骨软化和乏力持续。单纯补钙在骨科已经试过，并没有效果。
feedback.en: No. Drug-induced proximal tubular injury recovers slowly — often over weeks to months, and incompletely in some patients — and continued hypophosphataemia keeps the osteomalacia and weakness going. Calcium on its own has already been tried in orthopaedics without effect.

text.zh-CN: 重建病程：起病和进展、行走能力、骨科诊治和补钙效果
text.en: Reconstructed the course: onset and progression, walking, the orthopaedic work-up and the response to calcium

text.zh-CN: 问清乙肝及抗病毒药的名称、剂量和疗程，并问了止痛药和激素
text.en: Established the hepatitis B and the antiviral's name, dose and duration, and asked about painkillers and steroids

text.zh-CN: 查了生命体征、体型、脊柱和胸廓骨骼压痛及肌力
text.en: Checked the observations, build, spinal and chest-wall bony tenderness and power

text.zh-CN: 同时查看入院血生化、尿常规、24小时尿和血气，成对解读
text.en: Read the admission blood chemistry, urinalysis, 24-hour urine and blood gas together, as pairs

text.zh-CN: 调阅入院前的骨科化验和影像记录，发现5个月前已有低血磷
text.en: Reviewed the earlier orthopaedic blood results and imaging and found the hypophosphataemia documented five months before

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即判断尿磷为不适当的肾性失磷
text.en: Judged the urine phosphate as inappropriate renal phosphate wasting at the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即作出统一诊断，并排除了骨髓瘤、维生素D缺乏、远端肾小管酸中毒和原发性骨质疏松
text.en: Made the unifying diagnosis at the first attempt, having excluded myeloma, vitamin D deficiency, distal RTA and primary osteoporosis

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选对换药方案，并停用了阿德福韦酯
text.en: Chose the antiviral switch correctly at the first attempt and stopped adefovir

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选对代谢治疗，并开始补磷、骨化三醇和补钾
text.en: Chose the metabolic treatment correctly at the first attempt and started phosphate, calcitriol and potassium

text.zh-CN: 乙肝抑制不中断：停用阿德福韦酯并换用恩替卡韦或TAF，没有改用TDF、没有停用全部抗病毒药、没有继续阿德福韦酯
text.en: Kept hepatitis B suppressed without a gap: stopped adefovir and started entecavir or TAF, with no TDF, no stopping of all antivirals and no continued adefovir

text.zh-CN: 骨软化纠正前没有使用双膦酸盐
text.en: Gave no bisphosphonate before the osteomalacia was treated

text.zh-CN: 向患者解释病因和换药，并交代补磷和随访
text.en: Explained the cause and the drug change to him, and the phosphate and follow-up

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 良好表现：用通俗语言说明他三年的骨痛和无力与长期吃的乙肝药损伤肾脏、导致磷从尿里丢失有关，而不是单纯骨质疏松；说明换药不是停药——乙肝药必须继续吃，自己停药可能让肝炎突然加重；解释补磷、维生素D和补钾的目的及常见副作用（如补磷可能腹泻）；坦率告知恢复需要数周到数月，需要定期抽血、查尿；告诉他会上报药物不良反应；用复述确认他理解，不责备之前的医生，也不夸大预后。
judgeGuidance.en: Good performance: explains in plain words that three years of bone pain and weakness come from his long-term hepatitis B tablet damaging the kidneys and letting phosphate leak into the urine, not simply from thin bones; makes clear the tablet is being changed, not stopped — the hepatitis B treatment must continue and stopping it himself could make the hepatitis flare; explains what the phosphate, vitamin D and potassium are for and their common side effects (phosphate can cause diarrhoea); says honestly that recovery takes weeks to months with regular blood and urine tests; tells him the reaction will be reported; checks understanding with teach-back, without blaming earlier doctors or overpromising.

name.zh-CN: 病房护士

knowledge.zh-CN: 内分泌科病房护士。交班：新入院，卧床，不能自己下地，翻身需要协助。可以协助留取血、尿标本并送检，执行医嘱。不解读化验结果。
knowledge.en: Endocrine ward nurse. Handover: new admission, in bed, cannot get up by himself and needs help to turn. Can help take and send blood and urine samples and carry out orders. Does not interpret results.

name.zh-CN: 上级医师

knowledge.zh-CN: 苏格拉底式带教，不直接给出诊断。引导学员：每个尿液结果都要和同一时间的血液结果配对看；低磷时要问肾脏是在保磷还是在漏磷；骨质疏松和骨软化可以并存，补钙无效本身就是线索；成人获得性近端小管病要查用药史，并排除骨髓瘤；肌酐正常不等于肾小管正常；换药时抗乙肝治疗不能中断。原报告的处理是历史事实，不自动等于今天的推荐。
knowledge.en: Socratic preceptor who does not give the diagnosis away. Steers the learner to: pair every urine result with the blood result taken at the same time; ask, when phosphate is low, whether the kidney is conserving it or leaking it; remember that osteoporosis and osteomalacia can coexist and that failure of calcium is itself a clue; check the drug history and exclude myeloma in acquired adult proximal tubulopathy; remember that a normal creatinine does not mean a normal tubule; never let hepatitis B treatment lapse during a switch. The report's management is a historical fact, not automatically today's recommendation.

name.zh-CN: 临床药师

knowledge.zh-CN: 可以讲解核苷（酸）类似物的肾脏安全性：阿德福韦酯和TDF属核苷酸类似物，可有近端小管毒性；恩替卡韦需按肌酐清除率调整剂量；TAF的肾、骨安全性优于TDF；停用抗乙肝药可致肝炎急性加重。也可以讲解补磷、骨化三醇、枸橼酸钾和氯化钾的用法和监测，以及按规定上报药品不良反应。不提供本例的检查结果。
knowledge.en: Can explain the kidney safety of nucleos(t)ide analogues: adefovir and TDF are nucleotide analogues with possible proximal tubular toxicity; entecavir is dosed by creatinine clearance; TAF has better kidney and bone safety than TDF; stopping hepatitis B treatment can cause an acute flare. Can also explain how to give and monitor phosphate, calcitriol, potassium citrate and potassium chloride, and how to report an adverse drug reaction. Does not supply this patient's results.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：骨痛、骨折与“正常”肌酐背后的肾小管
title.en: Debrief: the tubule behind the bone pain, the fractures and the 'normal' creatinine

conclusion.zh-CN: 长期服用阿德福韦酯（10 mg/日，近10年）引起获得性范科尼综合征——血糖正常时的尿糖、低分子量蛋白尿、肾性失磷和失钾、低尿酸、高氯性代谢性酸中毒——导致低磷性骨软化，并与骨质疏松并存。入院前5个月已经记录过低血磷，却只按骨质疏松补钙。停用阿德福韦酯、改用恩替卡韦，并补磷、骨化三醇、钙剂和补钾后逐步恢复：停药后第5天血磷0.71 mmol/L，出院后约6个月0.81 mmol/L，尿糖转阴，能大步行走。
conclusion.en: Nearly ten years of adefovir (10 mg a day) caused an acquired Fanconi syndrome — glycosuria with a normal blood glucose, low-molecular-weight proteinuria, renal phosphate and potassium wasting, hypouricaemia and a hyperchloraemic metabolic acidosis — leading to hypophosphataemic osteomalacia alongside osteoporosis. Hypophosphataemia had been documented five months before admission but was treated as osteoporosis with calcium alone. After adefovir was replaced by entecavir, with phosphate, calcitriol, calcium and potassium, he recovered gradually: phosphate 0.71 mmol/L five days after stopping and 0.81 mmol/L about six months after discharge, urine glucose negative, walking with long strides.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 低血磷早在入院前5个月就被记录（0.45–0.65 mmol/L），当时肝肾功能、血钙和PTH正常，却只按骨质疏松补钙：这是本例错过的关键线索。
keyReasoning.en: Hypophosphataemia was documented five months before admission (0.45–0.65 mmol/L) with normal liver and renal function, calcium and PTH, yet it was treated as osteoporosis with calcium alone: the clue this case missed.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 配对解读：血糖4.1 mmol/L时尿糖++；α1微球蛋白168 mg/L；尿酸117 μmol/L；血钾3.1 mmol/L而尿钾79 mmol/24 h；Cl⁻ 111 mmol/L、HCO₃⁻ 13 mmol/L——近端小管多项转运缺陷。
keyReasoning.en: Read as pairs: glycosuria ++ with a blood glucose of 4.1 mmol/L; α1-microglobulin 168 mg/L; urate 117 μmol/L; potassium 3.1 mmol/L with 79 mmol/24 h in the urine; Cl⁻ 111 mmol/L with HCO₃⁻ 13 mmol/L — a generalised proximal tubular defect.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 血磷0.53 mmol/L时尿磷13 mmol/24 h（约400 mg/日）是不适当的肾性失磷，虽然低于实验室参考值——那个参考值适用于血磷正常的人。
keyReasoning.en: A urine phosphate of 13 mmol/24 h (about 400 mg a day) with a serum phosphate of 0.53 mmol/L is inappropriate renal phosphate wasting even though it is below the laboratory range — a range for people with a normal serum phosphate.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 肌酐103 μmol/L（CKD-EPI 2021估算eGFR约78 mL/min/1.73 m²）在消瘦、卧床的患者中高估肾功能；肾动态显像示滤过功能中度受损。作者也把“肌酐一直正常”列为误诊原因之一。
keyReasoning.en: A creatinine of 103 μmol/L (CKD-EPI 2021 eGFR about 78 mL/min/1.73 m²) overstates kidney function in a thin, bed-bound man; renal scintigraphy showed moderately impaired filtration. The authors name the 'always normal' creatinine as one reason for the misdiagnosis.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 鉴别诊断依据已记录的检查：骨髓象正常、血液肿瘤指标无异常（骨髓瘤/轻链病不支持），既往血钙和PTH正常（甲旁亢不支持），维生素D偏低不能解释肾小管缺陷，远端RTA不解释尿糖和低分子量蛋白尿。
keyReasoning.en: The differential rests on the recorded tests: a normal marrow and normal haematological tumour markers (against myeloma or light-chain disease), earlier normal calcium and PTH (against hyperparathyroidism), a low vitamin D that cannot explain the tubular defects, and distal RTA that does not explain the glycosuria or the low-molecular-weight proteinuria.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 恢复是缓慢的：停药后第2天血磷0.57、第5天0.71 mmol/L，出院后约6个月0.81 mmol/L；所以补磷不应等肾小管“自行恢复”。
keyReasoning.en: Recovery is slow: phosphate 0.57 mmol/L two days and 0.71 mmol/L five days after stopping, 0.81 mmol/L about six months after discharge — so phosphate replacement should not wait for the tubule to 'recover by itself'.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单个病例：因果判断为“很可能”而非证实——有合理的用药时间线、停药后改善和已排除的替代原因，但没有（也不应有）再激发；作者关于近10年未用其他药物的说法与病史中的止痛药相矛盾，止痛药种类不明。病例的决策和干预是教学设计；住院经过和随访是原报告的事实，不随学员的选择改变。
boundaries.en: A single case: causality is 'probable', not proven — a plausible drug timeline, improvement after stopping and alternatives excluded, but no (and no justifiable) rechallenge; the authors' statement that no other drug was taken for ten years conflicts with the painkillers in the history, whose type is unknown. The case's decisions and interventions are teaching design; the hospital course and follow-up are the report's facts and do not change with the learner's choices.

unknowns.zh-CN: 尿肌酐、尿pH、尿钙和尿氨基酸未报告，无法计算磷排泄分数或TmP/GFR。
unknowns.en: Urine creatinine, pH, calcium and amino acids were not reported, so FEPO₄ and TmP/GFR cannot be calculated.

unknowns.zh-CN: 血钠未报告，无法计算阴离子间隙。
unknowns.en: Sodium was not reported, so the anion gap cannot be calculated.

unknowns.zh-CN: 入院时的肝酶、白蛋白、HBeAg、治疗前HBV DNA、本次PTH、1,25-二羟维生素D和FGF23未报告。
unknowns.en: Admission liver enzymes, albumin, HBeAg, pre-treatment HBV DNA, a PTH at this admission, 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D and FGF23 were not reported.

unknowns.zh-CN: 25-羟维生素D单位印作mmol/L（按数量级应为nmol/L）。
unknowns.en: The 25-hydroxyvitamin D unit is printed as mmol/L (the magnitude implies nmol/L).

unknowns.zh-CN: 骨密度T值、骨扫描和MRI异常的部位、肾动态显像的GFR数值未报告；摘要称“重度骨质疏松”，正文未分级。
unknowns.en: Bone-density T-scores, where the bone-scan and MRI changes were, and the scintigraphic GFR were not reported; the abstract says 'severe osteoporosis' while the main text does not grade it.

unknowns.zh-CN: “血液肿瘤指标”包括哪些项目未说明。
unknowns.en: Which 'haematological tumour markers' were measured is not stated.

unknowns.zh-CN: 止痛药的名称、剂量和疗程（是否为非甾体抗炎药）未记录。
unknowns.en: The name, dose and duration of the painkillers (whether NSAIDs) are not recorded.

unknowns.zh-CN: 补磷制剂和剂量、氯化钾剂量、补磷疗程，以及更远期的骨密度、骨折愈合和乙肝随访未报告。
unknowns.en: The phosphate preparation and dose, the potassium chloride dose, how long phosphate was given, and later bone density, fracture healing and hepatitis B follow-up were not reported.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 近端小管病要成对读血、尿：血糖正常时的尿糖、低分子量蛋白尿、低尿酸、低钾伴尿钾丢失、高氯性酸中毒，以及低血磷时不适当的尿磷。低磷血症时肾脏本应几乎不排磷，所以不能用血磷正常人群的24小时尿磷参考值判断（Imel & Econs 2012；原报告讨论）。
teachingPoints.en: Read blood and urine as pairs to find a proximal tubulopathy: glycosuria with a normal blood glucose, low-molecular-weight proteinuria, hypouricaemia, hypokalaemia with urinary potassium loss, a hyperchloraemic acidosis, and inappropriate phosphaturia in hypophosphataemia. A hypophosphataemic kidney should excrete almost no phosphate, so a 24-hour urine range for people with a normal serum phosphate cannot be used to judge it (Imel & Econs 2012; the report's discussion).

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 换药不停药：《慢性乙型肝炎防治指南（2022年版）》建议用阿德福韦酯或TDF出现肾或骨疾病时改用恩替卡韦或TAF，EASL乙肝指南自2017年版起同样对肾、骨风险者首选这两种药；不要换成TDF，也不要停用全部抗病毒药——阿德福韦酯说明书黑框警告停药后肝炎可严重急性加重。原报告当天换用恩替卡韦，与今天的做法一致。
teachingPoints.en: Change the drug, never stop the treatment: the Chinese 2022 hepatitis B guideline advises switching from adefovir or TDF to entecavir or TAF when kidney or bone disease appears, and EASL hepatitis B guidance has preferred the same two drugs for kidney or bone risk since its 2017 edition; do not switch to TDF and do not stop all antivirals — the adefovir label's boxed warning describes severe acute hepatitis flares after stopping. The report's same-day switch to entecavir matches today's practice.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 骨软化可与骨质疏松并存：骨痛、骨折、身高下降、ALP升高加持续低血磷时，补钙无效本身就是线索。治疗是补磷加活性维生素D和钙，纠正骨软化前不用双膦酸盐。作者建议“一旦出现低血磷，应及时补磷”；原报告直到停药后血磷仍不升才加用补磷——今天应从诊断时开始。
teachingPoints.en: Osteomalacia can coexist with osteoporosis: with bone pain, fractures, height loss, a raised ALP and persistent hypophosphataemia, the failure of calcium is itself a clue. Treat with phosphate plus active vitamin D and calcium, and give no bisphosphonate until the osteomalacia is corrected. The authors advise prompt phosphate replacement once hypophosphataemia appears; the report added phosphate only when the level failed to rise after stopping the drug — today you would start it at diagnosis.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 纠正酸中毒和低钾：近端小管性酸中毒需要碱剂，枸橼酸钾可同时补钾和碱；碱剂会增加尿钾丢失，因此必须同时补钾。原报告只给了氯化钾口服溶液，没有记录碱剂。药物性范科尼综合征没有专门指南，这是肾内科常规做法（如StatPearls“范科尼综合征”所述的电解质替代和碱剂治疗）。
teachingPoints.en: Correct the acidosis and the potassium: proximal tubular acidosis needs an alkali, and potassium citrate replaces potassium and alkali together; alkali increases urinary potassium loss, so potassium must go with it. The report gave only oral potassium chloride and records no alkali. There is no specific guideline for drug-induced Fanconi syndrome; this is standard nephrology practice (electrolyte replacement and alkali therapy, as summarised in StatPearls 'Fanconi syndrome').

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 监测不能只看肌酐：在消瘦、卧床者中肌酐会高估肾功能（本例CKD-EPI 2021估算eGFR约78，而肾显像示中度受损）。作者建议长期服用阿德福韦酯者除肌酐外监测GFR、ALP、血气、24小时尿蛋白和尿钾、钙、磷，并监测血磷；阿德福韦酯说明书同样要求监测肾功能。
teachingPoints.en: Monitor more than the creatinine: in a thin, bed-bound patient creatinine overstates kidney function (here a CKD-EPI 2021 eGFR of about 78 against moderately impaired filtration on scintigraphy). The authors advise that long-term adefovir users have GFR, ALP, blood gas, 24-hour urine protein and urine potassium, calcium and phosphate monitored as well as the creatinine, plus serum phosphate; the adefovir label also requires renal monitoring.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 药物因果评估与上报：用药时间线、停药后改善、替代原因已排除，按Naranjo量表属“很可能”；不应再激发。应按《药品不良反应报告和监测管理办法》上报。
teachingPoints.en: Assess and report the reaction: a plausible drug timeline, improvement after stopping and alternatives excluded make it 'probable' on the Naranjo scale; rechallenge is not justified. Report it under the national adverse drug reaction reporting rules.
